ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971); Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada); Ley 526 de 1999, as amended by Ley 1128 de 2007 (UIAF AML/CFT framework); Decreto 830 de 2021, articles 1.4.2.1.1 to 1.4.2.1.14 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUBF); Decreto 663 de 1993 (Estatuto Orgánico del Sistema Financiero); Circular Única de la Superintendencia Financiera, due-diligence rules for insurance auxiliaries.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; consular legalization if the issuing country is not an Apostille Convention state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relevant companies registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney to Colombian counsel or incorporator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the grantor's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / tax residence certificate of corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Tax authority or corporate registry of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation and continuous screening of all directors, shareholders and beneficial owners against OFAC SDN, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, EU consolidated financial sanctions, the Colombian UIAF financial-interest list, and PEP databases; adverse hits trigger enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification, and rejection or supervisory filing.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES - Registro Único Empresarial y Social (www.rues.org.co), processed through the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá SIIS online pre-incorporation queue)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed name must use Latin characters; Spanish-language words are preferred. Foreign words may be used when written in Latin alphabet, and phonetic transliteration is accepted if supported by documentation. Accent marks are preserved in the registry. The denomination of an S.A.S. must end in 'S.A.S.' or 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: There is no statutory extension of the homonimia certificate; a new name search must be filed if the 30-day window lapses. On rejection, the applicant may file a right-to-petition and a reconsideration appeal (recurso de reposición) with the relevant Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days. If denied, the applicant may file the vertical administrative appeal (recurso de apelación) with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, and a constitutional tutela action remains available before the civil courts.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not accepted as the sole registered office. The S.A.S. must declare a real, physical address in Colombia and maintain evidence of entitlement to use that address for RUES and RUT registration. A virtual mailbox may be used for correspondence only and must not replace the statutory commercial domicile. Marine-survey operations additionally require a disclosed physical workplace meeting port and insurance-market expectations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate. Estimated 20-30% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 24 months, with elevated risk if the registered office is a residential or shared address, and increased oversight during marine-survey license validation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas), Articles 1-48; Código de Comercio, Articles 98, 110, 353-356 and 373-375; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, Book 1, Titles I and II (Chamber of Commerce and RUES regime)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá), operating through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES); post-registration oversight by the Superintendencia de Sociedades
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) executed by the shareholders and registered before the Cámara de Comercio; public deed (Escritura Pública) is mandatory only where real property is contributed to the company
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: A Colombian S.A.S. may be incorporated with zero capital (Article 3, Law 1258 de 2008); where partial payment is agreed, the unpaid portion of subscribed capital must be fully settled within a maximum of two years from incorporation. The law prescribes no statutory minimum and no escrow account for general S.A.S. formation, although proof of paid-up capital may be required by counterparties or by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia should the entity apply for an insurance auxiliary registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [SAS NAME]: (1) RESOLVED, that the share subscription stated in the incorporation instrument is ratified, and that [SHAREHOLDER] be issued [NUMBER] ordinary shares of COP [PAR VALUE] each, representing subscribed capital of COP [AMOUNT], with any unpaid portion payable within two years as permitted by Law 1258 of 2008. (2) RESOLVED, that the registered office be adopted at [ADDRESS], [CITY], Colombia, and the Legal Representative be authorized to lease premises and notify the DIAN and Chamber of Commerce. (3) RESOLVED, that [NAME] be appointed Legal Representative, with full powers to execute contracts, open bank accounts, and represent the Company. (4) RESOLVED, that these minutes be recorded and filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the proposed registered office through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) online portal (https://www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a prior name availability search on the RUES platform using the proposed corporate name. Verify that no identical or confusingly similar name is registered in the same Chamber jurisdiction. Submit an online request for name reservation; the Chamber issues a Homonymy Certificate and reserves the name for a renewable period not exceeding 30 days.
required_dossiers: Applicant identification document (cédula de ciudadanía or valid passport for foreign founders)
Completed name search and reservation request form (solicitud de búsqueda y reserva de nombre)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to prior similarity, submit an alternative name request. Formal objection may be filed before the Cámara de Comercio within 5 business days requesting a comparative analysis; the Chamber resolves the objection administratively without court proceedings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public (Notaría) only if real property is contributed; otherwise the incorporation document may be executed privately and authenticated before any notary or through certified digital signatures recognized in Colombia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución in Spanish, complying with Article 5 of Law 1258 de 2008: corporate name, domicile, corporate purpose, term, subscribed and paid capital, share classes and voting rights, governance rules, and audit provisions. Each founding shareholder signs the instrument; a notary authenticates signatures. If real property is contributed, elevate the instrument to an Escritura Pública and record it in the property registry.
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución drafted per Law 1258 de 2008, Article 5
Valid identification of each founding shareholder (cédula, NIT, or passport)
Power of attorney (poder especial) if a representative signs on behalf of any shareholder
Register of subscribed capital allocation and share issuance schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber or notary identifies deficiencies in the by-laws, execute a supplementary private instrument correcting the affected clauses and re-submit within 10 business days. No penalty is imposed for a first corrective filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Chamber of Commerce Registration and Certificate of Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social, filing through RUES or the Chamber's virtual transactional platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed incorporation instrument to the Chamber of Commerce together with the pre-RUT data capture and the beneficiary final disclosure. Pay the registration fee online via PSE. Upon approval, the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal and registers the company, the legal representative(s), and the registered office. Obtain three certified copies for use before banks, DIAN, and the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia.
required_dossiers: Signed and authenticated Documento Privado de Constitución
Pre-RUT registration information form (Pre-RUT) captured by the Chamber
Beneficiario Final sworn statement (información de beneficiario final)
Payment receipt for derechos de inscripción
Valid identification of the legal representative appointed in the incorporation instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried (requerimiento), respond within 10 business days with corrected by-laws or supplementary documents. Non-response causes rejection and the process must restart; a prompt response avoids a new registration fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: DIAN Tax Registration (RUT) and Electronic Invoicing Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), transactional portal (Sede Electrónica, RUT module)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register for the Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT) through the DIAN RUT electronic module within 10 business days after Chamber registration. Complete the RUT with the company name, tax status, head office address, CIIU codes (primary code 5222), and the date of incorporation. Activate the electronic invoicing mechanism (facturación electrónica) by obtaining the digital certificate and registering the invoicing software through the DIAN portal.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued by the Cámara de Comercio
Legal representative's identification document and authentication of signature
Corporate email address and registered office physical address
Certified copy of the by-laws if required by DIAN for large-taxpayer or withhold agent classification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT application due to address, activity code, or representative discrepancies, file an online correction (actualización del RUT) and resubmit within 5 business days. The rejection does not invalidate the corporate incorporation; the entity remains legally incorporated.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Filing with the Superintendencia de Sociedades
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia de Sociedades, digital filing through the SIREM or SIGLO platform; UBO disclosure is also captured by the Cámara de Comercio in the incorporation filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Beneficiario Final information identifying every individual who directly or indirectly holds at least 5% of the equity or exercises control. State the full legal person's shareholding chain up to the natural-person ultimate owners. File within 30 calendar days of incorporation and update the filing annually in January and whenever a conforming transfer occurs.
required_dossiers: Beneficiario Final questionnaire (Formato de Beneficiario Final)
Equity ownership documentation for each ultimate beneficial owner
Corporate organization chart demonstrating control chains
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late or inaccurate UBO filing is sanctionable with fines up to COP 200 million. Correct any defective filing by submitting an amendment through SIREM within 5 business days of discovery; voluntary correction mitigates sanctions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Employment, Occupational Safety, and Sectoral Licensing Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL), Caja de Compensación Familiar, Cuerpo de Bomberos local, Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC), and Dirección General Marítima (DIMAR) for port access
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company with an ARL (e.g., SURA, Positiva, Bolívar) for work-risk protection of all employees and with a Caja de Compensación (e.g., CAFAM, COLSUBSIDIO). Obtain the fire safety inspection certificate (Concepto de Bomberos) for the registered office. Implement and register the occupational safety and health management system (SG-SST) under Decreto 1072 de 2015 before employees begin field work. Where the marine surveyor requires access to port facilities, apply to DIMAR for port security credentials and comply with COAM port-access protocols.
required_dossiers: RUT and NIT certificate
Lease contract or public deed evidencing the registered office
Fire safety concept application sheet and building floor plan
SG-SST program and occupational risk classification for CIIU 5222
Employee payroll and worker registration forms (planilla PILA)
SFC application for the insurance auxiliary registry (Perito de Seguros Marítimos) with solvency and background certifications
DIMAR port-access request and background check documentation for maritime site visits
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire department issues a negative concept, implement corrective measures (extinguishers, emergency signage, egress adjustments) and request re-inspection within 15 business days. If the SFC auxiliary registration is incomplete, supplement the file within 10 business days to preserve the pending license validity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for the insurance auxiliary register (Perito/Ajustador de Seguros Marítimos); Dirección General Marítima (DIMAR) for maritime port-access and vessel boarding accreditation; Superintendencia de Puertos y Transporte for any ancillary maritime service operations
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorización e Inscripción como Auxiliar del Seguro – Perito de Seguros Marítimos (insurance auxiliary surveyor registration); DIMAR Port Facility Security Access Accreditation; Certificado de Investigación de Averías (open and particular average marine survey authorization) as customarily required by marine underwriters

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA); Regional Autonomous Corporation (CAR) of the registered office territory for local permits; DIMAR for marine pollution prevention clearances
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 – Registration-only / Exempt from full EIA: an office-based marine claims survey operation is not included in ANLA's mandatory environmental licensing list (Decreto 1076 de 2015, Article 2.2.2.3.2.1). A sectoral environmental registration may be imposed by the port administrator or the CAR for recurring port access. A full Environmental Impact Assessment becomes mandatory only if the company later constructs port infrastructure, dry docks, vessel fuel facilities, or hazardous cargo terminals.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero process effluent is expected from standard office survey operations. When survey activities involve waste-oil sampling, chemical cargo residue assessment, or vessel boarding, compliance is required with Resolution 0631 de 2015 (surface-water discharge limits), Decreto 4741 de 2005 (hazardous waste classification, manifest, and licensed gestor chain), Resolution 909 de 2008 and Resolution 2254 de 2017 (air emission and air quality thresholds). No bilge water, hydrocarbons, or ballast residues may be discharged to coastal waters; vessel-related waste discipline follows MARPOL requirements as enforced by DIMAR.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (Concepto Técnico de Bomberos) for the survey office; structural and occupancy clearance via the landlord's Certificado de Existencia Legal or local curatoría urbana habitability certificate; occupational safety and health management system (SG-SST) registered with the ARL under Decreto 1072 de 2015, Chapter 6, including workplace risk assessment for marine site visits. For physical access to restricted port perimeters, surveyors must hold a DIMAR port identification card (carné portuario) and complete the maritime security briefing prescribed by ISPS port facilities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (National Tax and Customs Authority); official portal: www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Upon incorporation, the S.A.S. must obtain a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) through the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) process on the DIAN portal. A foreign parent or non-resident shareholder must appoint a legal representative resident in Colombia to complete the RUT application, electronic signature registration, and tax responsibility classification. DIAN issues the NIT and activates the taxpayer's fiscal status for income tax, VAT, and invoicing obligations. Non-residents without a permanent establishment may obtain a NIT for withholding tax filings only.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; Colombian SAS is a separate taxable resident company subject to corporate income tax on worldwide income, with no pass-through status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime exists in Colombia. A SAS may only elect the 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' if annual gross income remains below the UVT-based statutory limit, and certain economic groups may elect the fiscal consolidation regime with DIAN authorization. Hybrid mismatch elections are not recognized under the Colombian Tax Code.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA – Impuesto sobre las Ventas (VAT), supplemented by sectoral excise taxes
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold for VAT registration. Any person or entity regularly making taxable supplies in Colombia must register in the RUT and be declared as a VAT responsible party. Non-resident providers of digital or offshore services are subject to VAT if the beneficiary is located in Colombia, without a pure turnover threshold unless exempted by statute.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) is compulsory for all VAT responsible parties. Invoices must be generated through a DIAN-authorized technological provider or the DIAN free portal, be digitally signed, and be transmitted in real-time for validation before issuance. Each invoice must include the CUF (Código Único de Facturación) and comply with XML tax-pack standards. Export invoices must expressly indicate the zero-rated or exempt status, and must be cleared through DIAN's real-time validation mechanism.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods must be physically exported from Colombia and leave the customs territory, supported by an export customs declaration. Services are zero-rated as exports when provided from Colombia to a non-resident recipient and the benefit is effectively used abroad, for services listed in Article 481 of the Tax Code, which includes marine surveying, technical consulting, and marketing services. The exporter/zero-rated supplier must hold a valid RUT, issue the electronic export invoice, and conform to the forex repatriation obligation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU – Declaración Aduanera de Exportación submitted through DIAN's Magnus system)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill with maritime or transport carrier stamp
Inward Remittance Certificate (prueba de reintegro de divisas) showing foreign currency entry through the Colombian foreign exchange market
Electronic export commercial invoice (factura electrónica de exportación)
Packing list and certificate of origin when applicable
Signed service agreement or survey report for export of services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN has extended audit powers to cross-verify export declarations, e-invoices, customs manifests, and FX transaction records. Failure to repatriate foreign currency within the statutory deadline or submission of forged export documentation triggers retroactive cancellation of the zero-rating, severe fines, and VAT refund clawback. Fraudulent zero-rating or refund claims expose the taxpayer to fines of up to 160% of the tax evaded, closure of establishment, and criminal liability under Law 1762/2015 and Tax Code Article 676.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual mercantile registration renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil) and RUES data validation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) through the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January to 31 March; no extension is granted by Chamber practice.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal surcharge plus daily arrears interest; failure to renew in three consecutive years causes cancellation of the commercial registration, loss of the right to operate the registered establishment, and procedural incapacity before commercial courts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of certified annual financial statements and the legal representative's management report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) / SIREM financial statements depository
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month after the annual shareholders' meeting approving the accounts; the ordinary meeting is held by 31 March, so the filing is generally due no later than 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Chamber of Commerce late filing penalties accrue per month of delay; the Chamber blocks subsequent RUES renewals, capital changes, and appointment of legal representatives until the financial statements are deposited; the Superintendencia de Sociedades may impose coercive fines.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% for fiscal years 2023 and thereafter (Art. 240 Estatuto Tributario, as enacted by Law 2277 of 2022). This applies to the Colombian S.A.S. marine cargo surveyor as an ordinary-income taxpayer.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sector-specific tax holiday applies to ISIC 5222 marine inspection services. Available general incentives: 30% income-tax discount for qualifying investments in research and technological development (Art. 256-1 E.T.); full deduction of the municipal Industry and Commerce Tax (ICA); VAT exemption treatment for certain maritime service exports if properly documented; no wealth-tax surcharge for the low-risk service sector. The effective rate for a profitable surveyor is therefore approximately 35% on net taxable income after ordinary deductions.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Indefinite (no statutory expiry); annual offset is capped at 10% of the current-year net taxable income determined before the loss compensation (Art. 147 E.T., reformed by Law 2277 of 2022). Tax losses must be measured in COP at the year-end exchange rate when originally incurred.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 210 — Declaración de Renta y Complementarios para Personas Jurídicas y Asimiladas; filed exclusively via the DIAN MUISCA electronic portal (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicios y Control Automatizado) at dian.gov.co.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual. The Colombian tax year is the calendar year (1 January to 31 December). Quarterly income-tax prepayments (anticipos) are required when the prior-year tax exceeds specific thresholds.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Deadlines are set each year by a DIAN resolution and are assigned according to the last two digits of the entity's NIT (tax identification number). For tax year 2024 returns, the filing window runs from mid-February to late April 2025. The payment due date is the same day as the filing deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ingresos brutos operacionales (gross operating income): aggregate marine survey fees invoiced to underwriters, shipowners, and cargo interests for hull inspection, cargo damage claims adjustment, and marine insurance loss reporting.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all income taxable in Colombia as services rendered in the national territory. Convert any foreign-currency invoice amounts at the official year-end representative market rate (TCRM); do not net broker commissions in this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Devoluciones, rebajas y descuentos (returns, rebates, and discounts): contractual reductions granted to underwriting clients.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only reductions actually granted and supported by credit notes. Adjust foreign-currency credit notes using the transaction-date exchange rate for accuracy.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ingresos netos (net income): gross operating income less returns, rebates, and discounts, plus non-operating income such as reimbursable travel expenses and subcontracted survey billing pass-throughs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include recoverable disbursements only if they form part of the client contract economics; otherwise disclose in costs. Non-resident parent-company charge-backs will be subject to transfer-pricing review.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costos de prestación de servicios (costs of rendering services): directly allocable costs for marine surveyor salaries, subcontractor fees, vessel boarding travel, ultrasonic testing equipment, and certification costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs paid to foreign related parties must comply with the arm's-length principle and be supported by contemporaneous benchmarking studies when the 165,000 UVT threshold is reached.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deducciones (deductions): general operating expenses, professional indemnity insurance, office rent, administrative payroll, depreciation of survey cameras and drones, and statutory reserve accruals.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions attributable to non-resident shareholders or affiliates (management fees, technical assistance) are subject to source-country withholding formalities and economic-substance scrutiny.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Renta líquida ordinaria (ordinary net income): net income less costs and deductions, before exempt income and presumptive income adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is the base for computing any distributable profits attributable to non-resident dividend withholding tax; maintain a clear reconciliation to audited financial statements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Rentas exentas (exempt income): include only income expressly declared exempt by DIAN, such as qualifying blue-economy port-related services. Marine cargo surveying is not automatically exempt.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If any exempt income is claimed, the separate accounting and exclusion rules of Article 284 E.T. apply. Unsupported exemption claims trigger a 100% inaccuracy penalty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Renta presuntiva (presumptive income): if 3.5% of the net equity at the prior year-end exceeds ordinary net income, the presumptive amount must be reported and taxed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fully-owned S.A.S. entities with large accumulated dividends receivable from abroad and little local income are at risk of presumptive taxation; structure capital contributions accordingly.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Pérdidas fiscales de ejercicios anteriores (tax-loss carryforward): losses available for offset under the indefinite carryforward regime, subject to the 10% annual cap.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses must have been previously reported on the annual return; a foreign-currency loss can be carried only in COP after conversion at the loss-year TCRM.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Renta gravable (taxable income): ordinary net income less exempt income less loss carryforward, adjusted for presumptive income; this is the 35% tax base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders should receive a reconciliation showing that only fully taxed profit will be available for dividend distribution at the 10% withholding rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Impuesto de renta y complementarios (income tax charge): apply the 35% statutory rate to Renglón 83.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify whether any preferential rate could apply to a qualified port or logistics activity; otherwise the standard 35% rate is mandatory.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Descuentos tributarios (tax credits): R&D investments, ICA tax credit recovery, and values paid abroad creditable under a DTA.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits for amounts paid to non-resident service providers are only admissible with Form 210 attachments and DIAN bank payment records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Impuesto neto (net tax): tax charge after applying credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This net amount drives the quarterly advance payment obligations for the following year and the dividend-distributable base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Saldo a pagar o saldo a favor (balance due or refund): net tax less prepayments, source withholdings, and excess payments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any refundable balance is subject to DIAN offset and automated pre-audit; non-resident ownership does not restrict refund eligibility provided the S.A.S. is up to date in its electronic filings.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of the tax due for each month or fraction of a month, up to a maximum of 100% of the tax; where no tax is due, the minimum sanction is one UVT (COP 47,065 in 2024). Late payment: monthly default interest (approximately 36.5% annualized, adjusted monthly) plus a 10% late-payment surcharge. Failure to file the supporting information return (Información Exógena): fine of up to 15,000 UVT (COP 705,975,000 in 2024). Rectification after DIAN notification adds a 100% inaccuracy penalty under Article 648 E.T.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% definitive withholding on dividends paid to a non-resident corporate or individual shareholder where the underlying profits were subject to the standard 35% entity-level income tax (Art. 245 E.T.). Distributions made from untaxed or exempt profits trigger a 35% withholding on the dividend. Resident Colombian shareholders pay an incremental progressive rate on excess dividends, but this is not relevant to the non-resident S.A.S. holding structure.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Where the shareholder is resident in a country with a DTA in force (such as Spain, Chile, Mexico, the United Kingdom, France, or Canada), the 10% rate may be reduced if the treaty so provides. Protocol: (1) obtain a Certificado de Residencia Fiscal (TRC) from the foreign tax authority; (2) apostille or legalize the TRC in accordance with Colombian rules of evidence; (3) submit the TRC and a signed beneficial-ownership declaration to the Colombian S.A.S. before the dividend registration date; (4) the S.A.S. applies the treaty rate at source only if the TRC is technically acceptable to DIAN; (5) retain the TRC for at least five years and disclose the cross-border payment via the annual Información Exógena. Where the treaty rate is not applied at source, the non-resident may file a refund claim with DIAN within two years of the payment date.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties on intellectual property and insurance-related technology licenses: 15% statutory withholding (Art. 408 E.T.); DTA-reduced to 5%–10% depending on the underlying treaty. Interest on external loans: 20% statutory withholding (Art. 408 E.T.); DTA-reduced to 10%–15%. Technical assistance and consulting fees paid to non-resident marine engineering providers: 15% statutory withholding, subject to DTA limitation if the provider is an enterprise without a Colombian permanent establishment.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File documentation when the previous-year gross income is at least COP 7,765,725,000 (165,000 UVT for 2024; UVT = COP 47,065) or when the entity is designated as a Gran Contribuyente by DIAN. The Country-by-Country report is required for multinational groups with consolidated annual income above COP 470 billion. Annual TP information must be electronically submitted via the TP annex (Form 220) together with the ordinary return.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not maintain a formal Economic Substance Regulation (ESR) code in the Gulf-cooperation sense; the S.A.S. is nonetheless subject to a robust substance-over-form doctrine under Art. 662 E.T., a general anti-avoidance rule (Art. 658 E.T.), and the judicially recognized economic substance test. A marine surveyor S.A.S. must prove real operational capacity: paid local employees, leased office premises, client contracts with independent insurers, and actual performance of inspections in Colombia. A conduit structure that merely invoices foreign-reinsurance charges and passes profits outward without operational reality is recharacterizable as a sham, with all resulting tax adjustments.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Understating gross marine survey fees in Formulario 210, issuing false inspection invoices to generate artificial costs, or recording fictitious subcontractor payments to related shell entities to eliminate the taxable base.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN correction with default interest; inaccuracy penalty of 100% of the omitted amount (Art. 648 E.T.); criminal tax evasion under Article 434A of the Criminal Code, as strengthened by Law 2277 of 2022, carrying 36 to 108 months of imprisonment and fines of up to 50,000 times the monthly legal minimum wage where the evasion exceeds 250 SMLMV.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives are solidarily liable for unpaid income tax and penalties (Art. 794 E.T.) when they sign returns containing false information. A criminal conviction can trigger asset seizure, travel bans, and disqualification from managing Colombian entities; the corporate veil is pierced upon proof of fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating or maintaining the S.A.S. exclusively as a shareholder-device to route underwriting commissions from foreign marine insurers to a non-resident parent, lacking local employees, premises, or survey execution capacity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: GAAR application under Art. 658 E.T. recharacterizing the transactions and imposing a 100% penalty on the abusive tax advantage; fines of up to 15,000 UVT (COP 705.9 million in 2024) for failing to report ultimate beneficial owners; the DIAN may disregard the entity for tax purposes entirely.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for the recharacterized taxes and for the removal of distributable assets; the courts may pierce the corporate veil to reach personal property. Directors authorizing sham contracts can face criminal charges for conspiracy to commit tax evasion and money-laundering facilitation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating without a UIAF-registered compliance program when receiving cross-border underwriter wire payments, failing to identify the beneficial ownership of the non-resident shareholder, or transacting with marine insurers from jurisdictions on the FATF watchlist without enhanced due diligence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative sanctions by the UIAF and the Superintendency of Companies, including fines up to COP 200 million per breach, suspension of the entity's commercial registration, and cancellation of the marine surveyor license. Criminal money-laundering charges (Art. 323 Criminal Code) carry 8 to 24 years of imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors with compliance oversight face personal fines of up to COP 38 million and disqualification; facilitation of transactions with the proceeds of crime exposes directors to imprisonment, travel restrictions, and forfeiture of personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare or file the Transfer Pricing Local File and the Información Exógena when the entity exceeds the 165,000 UVT threshold; paying engineering or reinsurance service fees to the overseas parent at non-arm's-length rates without benchmarking.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The difference determined by DIAN is fully taxed with interest and an inaccuracy penalty of up to 100%; failure to file the TP documentation and the exógena returns exposes the S.A.S. to fines of up to 15,000 UVT (COP 705.9 million in 2024).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative who certifies the TP annex is personally liable if supporting documentation was knowingly omitted; DIAN can issue personal collection proceedings against director assets; if the mispricing was intentional, the criminal fraud penalties of Article 434A of the Criminal Code apply.
